name: t5probe_a
description: Phase 3 T5 PROBE -- CANDIDATE A. Throwaway 1 km probe run, not a shippable scenario: it exists to answer the multicell initiation question against the classifier pre-registered in docs/phase3-t5-multicell.md §3, which was committed before this config was written. Expected: predicted SUPERCELL (docs §2.1) despite CM1's 'multicell' label. iwnd=4, CM1's 'Weisman-Klemp multicell' (WK 1982, MWR 110, 504-520), u = 35*tanh(z/3000), v = 0. umove is the MEAN 0-6 km wind (35*3000*ln(cosh 2)/6000 = 23.2 m/s), NOT Bunkers -- Bunkers is a supercell motion formula and this probe is asking whether this is a supercell at all. Residual drift is measured (M6). Probe geometry is T4 §5.2's: 180x180 @ 999 m = 179.82 km, 2 h, dtl=6, ~13 min per run instead of ~4.5 h at 333 m. The 1 km caveat is stated in docs §6.1 -- component counts may bias low; the REGIME call is what survives at this resolution.
